steps.text: Bring a shovel and a rope; an antidote helps against the scorpion.
steps.source: Required Equipment: Shovel, Rope, Recommended Antidote, Antidote Rune or Silver Amulet for facing Scorpion

steps.text: Dig open the hole west of the Ancient Temple entrance with your shovel and go down.
steps.source: Enter the cave that is directly west of the Ancient Temple entrance (Mapper Coords 126.81, 125.172, 7). You will need to use a Shovel to open the hole.

steps.text: Go north and east (trolls, rats) to the room with the well and use its lower-right corner to go down: a scorpion below.
steps.source: Follow this path to the north and east until you find the room with a well in it. "Use" the lower-right corner of the well to go down into it. Be prepared to face one or more Scorpions.

steps.text: The scale armor is in the chest.
steps.source: Open the chests to receive the Scale Armor
